name: @psyb0t/pibox
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted pibox (pi-coding-agent) server over MCP — run prompts and manage workspace files as tools.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running pibox instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp), exposing its 5 tools: run_prompt (invoke pi-coding-agent on a workspace and get its text response), list_files, read_file, write_file, and delete_file. pibox is self-hosted — you run the server yourself (PIBOX_API_MODE=1 + PIBOX_MCP_MODE=1, or PIBOX_MCP_MODE=1 alone as a sidecar) and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-pibox.

PIBOX_URL.description: Base URL of your running pibox server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

PIBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN.description: Bearer token, only if the pibox server was started with PIBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN set.

url.description: Base URL of your running pibox server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

token.description: Bearer token, only if the pibox server was started with PIBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN set.
